site_geometry.coordinates_note: present, filed_but_all_discarded and absent partition the published register exactly. filed_but_all_discarded named a site whose every mapped block was malformed, which is not the same as naming no site at all. untyped_blocks_skipped is counted only within filings carrying no PRIMARY block, because non-primary blocks are dropped before this stage.
site_geometry.corroboration_note: inside / (inside + elsewhere). Rows within 555 m of a named district's edge are published as `boundary` and excluded from both sides, because the mapped line cannot decide them; `offshore` and `unmapped` are excluded too, as neither is a disagreement about the district. Widening the tolerance moves rows from `elsewhere` into `boundary` and raises the rate; narrowing it does the reverse.
site_geometry.note: Coordinates come from the KML the proponent filed. The verdict compares them with the district the same filing names, using boundaries from a different source, so it is the one check on location the filing did not itself make.

appraisal_coverage.note: This instrument does not yet hold an appraisal history for every proposal. Every timing figure is computed over the proposals it does hold, and states that count. The proposals without one are overwhelmingly older filings, so this is a gap in what has been read and not a property of the register.

site_data_vintage.note: Counts of discarded, single-corner and untyped blocks are measured only for locations extracted by the current reader. Where this is non-zero those counts are a floor, not a total, and the affected rows carry `old` in `sq`.

contact_details_removed.note: Proponent names are published: an applicant is a party to a public regulatory proceeding and naming them is what the register is for. Email addresses and phone numbers found in free-text fields are removed - they identify a way to reach a private person and say nothing about the project.

status_vocabulary.note: The register records one position under several spellings. Filters and counts resolve through the canonical key so they cannot disagree; stages.json carries the mapping.

vintage_warning: The socio-economic profile is Census 2011. It is the most recent complete sub-district enumeration of India; the 2021 Census has not been conducted. Every figure describes the population as it was enumerated in 2011 and is presented on that basis.
